node.title: Re^3: Uncontrolled Format String - Checkmarx issue
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I agree with everything that [Corion] and [marto] have [id://11149155|written]. Checkmarx is giving you the error, so Checkmarx also needs to tell you how to fix it.

As I indicated, [id://11149116|above] I was only guessing what the problem might be, and in this case I can also only guess that maybe Checkmarx wants you to confirm that $err_rate really does contain a float. But Perl is notoriously hard to parse, so I have no idea what code the tool would accept for that check, so again, you'd have to look at the Checkmarx documentation or ask them. And if [Corion] [id://11149158|is right] that %% is the problem, then the tool is giving you a false positive (which proves my point), and you need to talk to Checkmarx support.
